name: CoorI
comment: Returns vertices of an I section centered on the origin. Argument order is h, b, tf, tw, then optional isRepeatFirstPoint. h is the overall height, b the flange width, tf the flange thickness, and tw the web thickness. Vertex order starts at the top-left and runs clockwise around the profile. isRepeatFirstPoint defaults to FALSE; TRUE appends the first vertex again. Non-numeric sizes return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
